# Voice & Verve

> Online English speaking, public speaking and personality development coaching for kids, teenagers and professionals. Founded by Adv. Ritu Khera — TESOL certified educator and Supreme Court Advocate with 20+ years of teaching experience. Based in Gurgaon, serving all of India and worldwide.

## About

Voice & Verve is a premier online coaching founded by Adv. Ritu Khera. She is a TESOL certified English educator, Supreme Court Advocate (LL.M), and public speaking expert with over 20 years of teaching experience and 300+ students coached. All sessions are personalised, live, and 1-on-1.

## Programs

- [Public Speaking Classes](https://voiceandverve.in/courses.html): Online public speaking and personality development classes for kids and adults. Helps students overcome stage fright, build commanding presence, and speak confidently in any room.
- [Basic English Grammar](https://voiceandverve.in/courses.html): English grammar coaching for CBSE, ICSE, IB and Cambridge board students (Class 4–10). Covers tense, voice, narration, comprehension and written English.
- [Interview Preparation](https://voiceandverve.in/courses.html): Interview coaching for freshers and working professionals. Covers HR rounds, group discussions, technical interviews and executive communication.
- [Table Manners & Etiquette](https://voiceandverve.in/courses.html): Dining etiquette, social confidence, body language and poise for children and adults.

## About the Founder

Adv. Ritu Khera is a TESOL certified English educator, Supreme Court Advocate, and public speaking coach based in Gurgaon, India. She holds an LL.M degree and has been teaching English communication for over 20 years. She has coached 300+ students across India and worldwide through personalised online sessions.
